title: 第74章:唐门破忍，雷法清场

第74章:唐门破忍，雷法清场-《道士下山之749局》

黑风岭夜色如墨，山林雾气浓稠如浆，将整列专列笼罩在一片阴冷朦胧之中。

车顶之上，五道黑衣黑影身形飘忽，踏风掠影，动作轻盈诡谲，正是甲贺上忍带队的暗杀小队。他们隐于夜色雾气之间，气息收敛到极致，寻常修士根本察觉不到半点踪迹。

甲贺忍擅长隐匿、幻术、分身、近身刺杀，行事阴狠，从不正面硬撼，专挑破绽偷袭，一击得手便遁走，难缠至极。

方才布下大范围迷心幻术，本想悄无声息侵蚀车厢内众人心神，趁众人陷入幻境意识沉沦之时，破窗而入逐一暗杀。

可万万没想到，整列列车竟被一层无形阵法牢牢护住，幻术刚侵入车厢便被硬生生碾碎，连半点心神影响都没能造成。

阵法的气息古朴厚重，带着正统道门符箓的镇煞之力，显然是提前布下的后手。

车顶领头的甲贺上忍面色阴沉，眼底闪过一丝诧异。

这群华夏修士，竟早有防备。

既然幻术失效，那就只能强行强攻。

五道黑影分散站位，分别锁定列车五处薄弱窗口，手中短刃泛着幽蓝冷光，淬满诡异阴毒，只要刺入肉身，灵气凝滞，道心受损，修为瞬间被压制大半。

车厢过道内，胡九郎负手而立，神色淡漠，仿佛压根没把车顶的忍者放在眼里。

范梦雪周身雷光隐隐跳动，眉宇间带着神霄弟子的刚正傲气，雷法本就克制阴邪诡术，对上甲贺忍的潜行暗杀，天生压制。

“交给我和师妹便可。”王欣欣身形一闪，已然掠到车厢连接处，眼底锋芒毕露，“甲贺忍擅长潜行隐匿，正面斗法不是他们强项，近身暗杀、暗器反制，正是我们唐门本行。”

话音未落，她抬手一挥，数十枚细如牛毛的银质透骨针，悄无声息穿透车窗缝隙，朝着车顶五道黑影而去。

针影细密，速度极快，带着淬过的迷魂毒，无声无息，专破忍者隐身气息。

车顶甲贺上忍面色一变，连忙低喝：“散开！是唐门暗器！”

五道黑影瞬间分身闪避，身形分化出十余道虚影，真假难辨，想要以分身术混淆视线，避开暗器突袭。

“雕虫小技。”一旁的茉沫俏皮一笑，手中甩出一卷银色软索，软索在空中瞬间散开，化作细密丝网，笼罩车顶大片区域，“甲贺分身术骗得了别人，骗不了我们唐门辨气之术！”

唐门自幼修炼辨气识踪之法，能透过虚妄幻影，锁定真人本体的气息波动。

茉沫眸光一凝，软索骤然收紧，精准缠向其中一道最浓郁的黑影气息。

噗嗤！

软索缠中肉身，那名甲贺忍者避无可避，被硬生生拽得身形一滞，分身幻影瞬间破灭。

王欣欣趁势跟进，指尖再扣三枚菱形飞镖，破空而出，精准命中那名忍者肩头。

淬毒飞镖入肉，那名忍者浑身一僵，气息瞬间萎靡，体内灵气被毒素凝滞，再也无法运转遁术。

短短瞬息之间，一名甲贺忍者便被制服，失去战力。

车顶其余四名忍者见状，心头大惊。

本以为凭借甲贺忍的潜行幻术，足以碾压这批华夏修士，没想到刚一交手，就被唐门二女压制得毫无还手之力。

“一起强攻，速战速决！”甲贺上忍低喝一声，四道黑影不再游走试探，同时发力，手中忍刃划破夜色，从四个方位同时破窗，直扑车厢之内。

阴冷的寒气裹挟着浓烈的杀意，瞬间涌入过道。

“来得好！”范梦雪眼神一凛，抬手捏动雷法印诀。

Chapter 74: The Tang Sect breaks through the forbearance, and the thunder method clears the field - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The night in Heifeng Ridge is as dark as ink, and the fog in the mountains and forests is as thick as pulp, shrouding the entire special train in a cold and hazy atmosphere.

On the roof of the car, five black figures in black were erratic, flitting in the wind, and their movements were light and strange. They were the assassination team led by Jōnin Koga.They were hidden in the night mist, and their auras were so condensed that ordinary monks could not detect any trace of them.

Koga Ninja is good at stealth, illusions, clones, and close-quarters assassinations. He acts viciously and never confronts anyone head-on. He specializes in finding weak spots for sneak attacks. He can escape as soon as he succeeds in attacking, making him extremely difficult to deal with.

He had just laid out a large-scale enchantment spell, intending to quietly erode the minds of everyone in the carriage. While everyone was in the illusion and sinking in consciousness, he broke in through the windows and assassinated them one by one.

But he never expected that the entire train was firmly protected by an invisible formation. As soon as the illusion invaded the carriage, it was crushed to pieces without causing even the slightest mental impact.

The aura of the formation is simple and thick, and it carries the evil-suppressing power of the orthodox Taoist talismans. It is obviously a back-up plan deployed in advance.

The leading Jōnin Koga on the roof of the car looked gloomy, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.

This group of Chinese monks were already on guard.

Since the illusion is ineffective, the only option is to attack forcefully.

Five black shadows spread out and locked onto the five weak windows of the train. The short blade in their hand glowed with a blue cold light and was filled with strange and sinister poison. As long as it penetrated the physical body, the spiritual energy was stagnant, the Taoist heart was damaged, and most of the cultivation level was suppressed in an instant.

In the carriage aisle, Hu Jiulang stood with his hands behind his hands, his expression indifferent, as if he didn't even pay attention to the ninja on the roof.

Fan Mengxue's body was faintly pulsing with lightning, and her brows carried the righteousness and arrogance of a disciple of Shenxiao. The thunder method was already capable of restraining evil and evil tricks, and was naturally suppressed by the stealth assassination of Koga Ninja.

"Just leave it to me and my junior sister." Wang Xinxin flashed and reached the connection between the carriages, her eyes sharp, "Koga Ninja is good at stealth and concealment. Head-on combat is not their strong point. Close-range assassination and hidden weapon countermeasures are our specialty in the Tang Sect."

Before she finished speaking, she raised her hand and waved, and dozens of silver bone-penetrating needles as thin as cow hair quietly penetrated the gap in the car window and headed towards the five black figures on the roof.

The needle shadow is fine, extremely fast, and carries the tempered ecstasy poison. It is silent and special in breaking through the invisibility of ninjas.

The expression of the jonin on the roof of the car changed, and he quickly shouted: "Spread out! It's a hidden weapon of the Tang Sect!"

The five black shadows instantly dodged and separated into more than ten phantoms. It was difficult to tell the real and fake shadows. He wanted to use the cloning technique to confuse his vision and avoid the hidden weapon attack.

"It's a small trick." Momo on the side smiled playfully and threw out a roll of silver soft rope in his hand. The soft rope instantly spread out in the air and turned into a fine mesh, covering a large area on the roof of the car. "Koga's clone technique can fool others, but it cannot fool us, the Tang Sect's Qi Discrimination Technique!"

Tang Men has been practicing the method of identifying aura since he was a child, and he can identify the aura fluctuations of the real person through false phantoms.

Momo's eyes narrowed, and the soft rope suddenly tightened, accurately wrapping around one of the strongest black shadow auras.

Poof!

The soft rope entangled his body, and the Koga ninja was unable to avoid it. He was forcefully pulled to a halt, and his clone phantom was instantly shattered.

Wang Xinxin took advantage of the situation and followed up, clasping three more diamond-shaped darts with her fingertips, flying out of the air, and accurately hitting the ninja's shoulder.

The poison-quenching dart penetrated the flesh, and the ninja's body froze, his aura instantly withered, and the spiritual energy in his body was stagnated by the toxin, and he could no longer use his escape technique.

In just an instant, a Koga ninja was subdued and lost his fighting power.

The other four ninjas on the roof were shocked when they saw this.

I thought that the stealth illusion technique of the Koga Ninja was enough to crush these Chinese monks, but I didn't expect that as soon as they fought, they were suppressed by the two girls of the Tang Sect and were unable to fight back.

"Let's attack together and fight quickly!" Jōnin Koga shouted, and the four black shadows stopped wandering around to test, and exerted force at the same time. The ninja blades in their hands cut through the night, broke the windows from four directions at the same time, and rushed into the carriage.

The cold air, packed with strong murderous intent, instantly poured into the corridor.

"Well done!" Fan Mengxue's eyes flashed, and she raised her hand to squeeze the Thunder Seal Technique.
